name: Continuous navigation in the existing file preview
statement: Users move backward and forward through eligible files without closing the existing preview, preserving current folder context and wrapping at both ends.
requiredProperties: Left/Right in current visible sorted order
default images, music/audio and video; skip other types and directories
wrap last to first and first to last
do not intercept typing, dialogs or media seeking
retain authenticated scoped read path and bounded preview resources

provenance.sourceReference: Owner requests 2026-10-15: preserve Working v1, add Left/Right to existing preview, document pleasant/elegant continuous browsing rationale
